## Start with the monitoring records.

Begin by meticulously collecting all available air quality monitoring data from the industrial facility and surrounding areas. This includes:

*   **Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS) data:**  This is real-time data showing pollutant concentrations directly from the source.
